github_surges.description: The agent skills I use every day. Works with Claude Code and Codex.
AI digital-human talking-head videos from one photo: Renoise MCP generation + 5 editing styles + 48 creator-grade packaging components. Agent skill for Claude Code / Codex / OpenClaw / WorkBuddy …
One persona, many coding agents. Replace or inject system prompts across codex, claude, opencode, grok, omp, hermes, pi, zcode - with a local web console.
Evidence-first genealogy skill for AI agents (Codex, Claude Code): church books, civil, military, deportation and repression records across the former USSR. Replies in your language.
A community-built phone app for Clean Your TV: clean up an Android TV from your phone. No laptop, no coding agent, nothing uninstalled.
Agent Skills that teach coding agents to write, review, and port idiomatic Rust, plus a tested clippy config. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, and Gemini CLI.

Run many Claude Code and Codex agents side by side, in one sidebar that tells you which one needs you. An unofficial fork of Warp.
Everything you need for building an agent. A Go library for the LLM tool-calling loop with budgets, hooks, skills, and tracing.

High-performance, memory-efficient Rust web crawler & content extraction engine for AI agents and RAG. Adaptive crawling, clean Markdown, structured data, PDF/RSS parsing, browser rendering, Firecrawl-compatible APIs, and Python/Node.js SDKs.
